item.title: Vietnam: Five Strategic Breakthroughs to Drive Digital Economy
item.description: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh has called for five strategic breakthroughs in digital data development to make data a high-value national asset, strengthen security and drive Vietnam’s digital economy.

item.title: Singapore Health Information Bill Enhances Care Coordination
item.description: Singapore’s Health Information Bill establishes a legal framework for secure, interoperable health data sharing, strengthening digital infrastructure and enabling coordinated care across the healthcare system.

item.title: Malaysia: MIDA Shares Tech-Driven Investment Framework for 2026
item.description: MIDA is reshaping Malaysia’s 2026 investment strategy around digital facilitation, technology upgrading and outcome-based incentives to strengthen domestic-led growth.

item.title: New Zealand: New AI Pilot to Boost Small Businesses Productivity
item.description: New Zealand’s AI Advisory Pilot will help small businesses adopt artificial intelligence tools to boost productivity, drive sustainable growth and navigate ethical, practical and operational challenges.

item.title: Australia: UNSW Develops Secure Multimodal Artificial Intelligence
item.description: UNSW researchers are developing secure multimodal AI systems for dynamic defence environments, supported by ADF funding to strengthen sovereign capabilities.

item.title: India: Scaling Language AI and Driving AI Literacy
item.description: India is strengthening its language AI ecosystem through BHASHINI and advancing AI literacy among youth with YUVA AI for All, fostering inclusive, ethical and citizen-centric AI for social and economic empowerment.

item.title: Hong Kong: Automated Nanotech Advances Single-Cell Manipulation
item.description: An automated robotic nanoprobe enables label-free extraction of functional mitochondria from living cells, advancing precision single-cell research and therapeutic exploration.

item.title: Vietnam: Innovation, Digitalisation and Sustainability Drive Growth
item.description: Vietnam is transforming its growth model, shifting from low-end manufacturing to high-tech, digital and green industries, driven by AI, innovation, creativity and a skilled domestic workforce.

item.title: Singapore Enhances Public Data Governance to Better Serve Citizens
item.description: Singapore has amended the Public Sector (Governance) Act to allow agencies to share and use data more effectively with external partners, enhancing citizen services while maintaining safeguards.

item.title: Exclusive Insight! The AI-Driven Data Universe: Turning Complexity into Strategic Advantage
item.description: Building unified, well-governed and resilient data foundations is the first essential step toward unlocking an AI-driven future for Singapore’s public sector, enabling better services for citizens.
